beta.notes:
Native Plex client for MiSTer. Built for CRTs at 480i over Component, RGB, S-Video or Composite, with 480p on HDMI.

Beta access. This is a paid early-access build. Install and browsing work without a code. Playback needs the code from the MisterZine Patreon post. Stable releases will be free and codeless.

New in beta.8
- A black screen on Play now diagnoses itself. The first time playback ends without a picture, the player spends a couple of seconds checking how your server answers, whether the stream arrives, and whether colour bars reach the screen. If you see bars for two seconds after a failed play, that is this test. Then run MisterZine-Plex-Diagnostics from Scripts and send the report; it now also carries the video settings of your MiSTer.ini, which main binary is running, the framebuffer mode and whether the installed files are intact. Server addresses and account details are never included.
- A menu that flashes to black recovers within a frame. MiSTer wipes the picture memory whenever its framebuffer mode is written; the app now notices at once and redraws, instead of leaving the screen black until the next change.
- A flickering menu also explains itself. The app now notices when something else writes into the picture memory it draws into, when MiSTer changes the framebuffer mode under it, or when the frame it just drew reads back black, and counts those in the same report.

Requirements
- Networked MiSTer on current MiSTer Linux
- 250 MB free on the SD card
- Plex account with a server that can transcode

Install
1. Download the Beta installer below and put it in the SD card's Scripts folder.
2. Run it from Scripts.
3. Follow the sign-in screen at plex.tv/link.

Already on an earlier beta: open Options > Updates in the app and install from there.

NTSC 480i only; PAL isn't supported yet.

This is unstable beta software. It talks to your real Plex account: playback, watched marks and resume points change your library, and a bug could change them wrongly. Use it at your own risk; no responsibility is taken for what it does to your library or your MiSTer.
